say:1:1430105201:1.text: Well, of course, it can be used to brew beer!
say:1:1430105201:1.source_cn: 当然是拿去酿比面包更重要的啤酒了！

say:2:1430105202:1.text: Beer is ten—no, one hundred—times more important than bread! After all, beer flows through our veins.
say:2:1430105202:1.source_cn: 啤酒可比面包重要十、一百倍！毕竟我们矮人身体中流淌着就...

say:3:1430105203:1.text: I mean, as long as there is enough bread, it's fine. As for beer... no Dwarf would ever think there is enough beer in the world!
say:3:1430105203:1.source_cn: 面包够吃就好，至于啤酒……从没有矮人会觉得啤酒够喝！
